text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян is training for her second
Sprinters
Stakes, but this time, it's not
only the race she's
preparing for.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, Big Bro. About today's training...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: You want me to take pictures?

text_block_list.text: Hey, Big Sis. About today's training...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: You want me to take pictures?

text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah, that too. But also, is it okay if
we end a
little early today?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I'll make up for the lost time by working
extra
hard! Whaddya say?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I've got an UmaTube vid I wanna upload
today,
but I'm not done editing it yet.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
This is the price I pay for having so much
fun with
last night's back-to-back
Umastagram and
Umatter streams!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
She's busy managing all of her different
social
media accounts in preparation for
the Cutie ♪
Derby. I'd love to lighten
her load, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.text:
As long as we can end early, that's all I
need!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
With that out of the way, let's get
started with
today's training! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян completes the training we
have
planned at an alarming pace and
leaves with a
smile on her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She looks like she's doing fine, but from
what I
can tell, she has an awful lot on
her plate. I hope
she really is all right.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: One day, I get an unexpected visitor...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(Адмайр Вега. She's a year above Curren
Chan in
the Twinkle Series, but she's
also her roommate,
so I hear about her
from time to time.)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It looks like she has something to say,
but this
strange silence continues... until
she seems to
make up her mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...I came to complain about Curren.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
She's been staying up all night recently,
and it's
bothering me.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
And it's annoying that she's always on
her phone
or computer.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
...It used to be that I couldn't get her to
shut up,
but now she doesn't even say a
word to me.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян is a perfectionist. She
doesn't show
it on the outside, but it
seems like she really has
been pushing
herself too hard...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's your job to manage her, isn't it? Do
you call
this doing your job? What are
you gonna do if she
works herself sick
and collapses?
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
Did you hear me?! I'm not
worried—these are
complaints!
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, as her trainer, you need to
take better
care of her.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text: That's all.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
Адмайр Вега walks out... and I spot
something
shiny on top of the shelf by
the door.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It probably belongs to Адмайр Вега. I
have to go
after her!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...In summary, unable to find Ayabe,
you've come
to me, the leader of Rito
Dorm?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I believe I grasp the situation. But, you
know,
Ayabe's not the type to—
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oh! I get it now. That Ayabe is always so

indirect...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ahem. Excuse me. I know Curren is your
trainee,
but you are aware it's against
the rules for trainers
to come into the
dorm, right?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
So you realize, then, that there's nothing
more I
can do for you.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
...But, y'know, being dorm leader is
much more
difficult than people make it
out to be.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I might even end up nodding off for,
say... ten
minutes.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: ...I'm actually worried about Curren too.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I'll leave this to you.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...I wait, but she doesn't answer. I don't
hear a
single sound from inside her
room...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's your job to manage her, isn't it? Do
you call
this doing your job? What are
you gonna do if she
works herself sick
and collapses?
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
Something might have happened to
Каррен Тян!
I swing the door open,
and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Someone there?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Someone there?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Wait, Big Bro?! What are you doing
here?!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Wait, Big Sis?! What are you doing
here?!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Oh... So Ayabe snuck you our dorm key,
and even
Fuji was worried enough to let
you in.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...I'm so lame.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
But... I can't believe Ayabe would
pretend to
forget her key like that.
What a roundabout way
to go about
it. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm sorry for worrying you. I'm
doing just
fine, though!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm sorry for worrying you. I'm
doing just
fine, though!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Looking around her room, I can see that,
while it's
clean enough at first glance,
there are a lot of
energy drink and
coffee cans hidden out of
sight...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's also a pile of cardboard boxes
labeled
"For Distribution". It looks like
she's doing even
more work than I
thought.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Judging by your face, you want to tell
me not to
push myself so hard.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
But it's not that big of a deal. I'm just a
liiittle
sleepy after staying up late
editing UmaTube
vids. That's all.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
At least, that's what I want to say, but...
maybe I
am in a bit over my head.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
This was my plan, but I didn't realize
how much
time classes, training, and the
constant social
media updates would
take! I'm worn out!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: But still... Please let me do this.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: But still... Please let me do this.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
My goal is still a long, long way off. I
can't stop
until I get there.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I refuse to compromise or give up on my
dream!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Besides, remember what you told me at
the shrine
back around New Year's?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Besides, remember what you told me at
the shrine
back around New Year's?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
You told me you were sure I could be a
champion.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I won't let it affect my races. After all... this is something I need to do for myself. I won't ask you to get involved.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: So—
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I'll help!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Really?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I know you can do it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I know you can do it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is it—the make-or-break point. So
please, let
me do this!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Please?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: R-really?!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be reckless. I'm gonna push
myself to
the brink... But I won't let
anyone see how much
it's wearing me
out.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Are you sure that's okay with you?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Are you sure that's okay with you?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's my job as her trainer to stop
her. If she
breaks down here, she'll lose
everything. On top
of that, I do really
want her to rest from the
bottom of my
heart, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
From everything Каррен Тян and I have
been
through together, I know that the
best thing I can
do to support her is to
believe in her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Bro. I'll definitely pull
this off!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sis. I'll definitely pull this
off!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Big Brooo! How was I?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Big Siiis! How was I?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Yay! ♪ Keep praising me!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Каррен Тян is running
at the
training course with a big smile
and her full
sharpness on display,
showing me that she's
pushed through
the worst of it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
